This is a great little pattern for girls' dresses!

I made size 10 for my soon-to-be 10-yr-old daughter. It fits her nicely with a couple of inches of ease. I made view A. I really wanted to make the matching purse (because I just really like making bags), but my daughter is so practical and told me that she already has 1 purse and that is enough. The dress was very quick and easy to sew. I don't think I changed much at all. The one thing that I did differently was fully line the skirt. I usually hem the lining separate from the main fabric skirt, but this time I decided to make the dress a little more casual and "play-able" and put the lining and main skirt together at the bottom hem edge. I under-stitched the lining on the lower hem edge, and then I topstitched it together too. Nice and neat! I basted the bodice-edge of the skirt together, gathered it together, and attached it to the bodice. On the inside, the overlocked seams are the bodice/skirt and the sleeve/bodice; everything else is finished.

She's wearing the dress with a braided belt that she already had, but we have plans to get some 1" pink grosgrain ribbon to use as a sash.

The little sleeves are my favorite. Highly recommend this pattern!

Edit: Here's the link in case anyone else wants to make it! I think I got the pattern at a Hobby Lobby $1/Simplicity sale.
